format: Vanilla 26.3 whole starts of large structures. starts: one per line, for each target (world 0 monument x3, mansion x2; world 2 bastion_remnant x1 per start pool variant: units, hoglin_stable, treasure, bridge; world 3 end_city x4) its first starts found by a spiral over the grid cells of its random spread structure set around the origin (cells whose potential chunk passes isStructureChunk and has a biome of the structure in its middle column, then createStructures): dimension, seed, min_y, height, w (world index of structure_starts), structure, chunk, references, bb, pieces (as in structure_starts), decorated (every chunk a piece's box intersects, z outer then x). Per start on fresh chunks, applyBiomeDecoration with structures ran for the decorated chunks in that order (each chunk's dependencies first, as in structure_decoration: starts within 8 of the referenced chunks, references, biomes, terrain with the Beardifier). chunks: one per line per decorated chunk: s (start index), chunk [x, z], the structure_decoration chunk format (sections, heightmaps, post_processing, block_entities, block_ticks, fluid_ticks) and entities [[type id, x, y, z], ...] that its decoration added, in addFreshEntity order.
